source.name: Steelworker
source.originalDescription: Dhelmise is granted a shield whenever one of the user's moves deals damage to Pokémon from the opposing team (5s cd). Each time this Ability or other effects grant the Pokémon a shield, the Pokémon's next basic attack deals increased damage. This effect can stack up to 3 times. When the shield granted by this ability expires after 3s, HP proportional to the amount of remaining shields is restored.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Steelworker は シールドを付与する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う。

source.name: Seaweed Snare
source.originalDescription: Has the user throw their anchor and ensnare a designated Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage and leaving the target unable to act for 0.45s. The user then charges at the target, dealing damage and leaving them unable to act for 0.45s. If other Pokémon from the opposing team are hit by the anchor or the charge, they take damage and are shoved for 0.7s. Applies a cleansable damage over time effect to Pokémon on the opposing team that deals damage on hit and every 0.5s up to 9 times, healing Dhelmise with each tick based on damage dealt. The duration of the DoT is refreshed with each hit of the Unite Move. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Seaweed Snare は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、相手を打ち上げる、相手を押し出す、与ダメージを変化させる、待ち時間を短縮する、HPを回復する、シールドを付与する、継続ダメージを与える。
